versions.content: If the parameter SomeIpTp_VersionInfoPtr of the API SomeIpTp_GetVersionInfo() equals NULL_PTR and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. SomeIpTpDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE), the function SomeIpTp_Get VersionInfo, the API Det_ReportError()shall be called with the development error code SOMEIPTP_E_PARAM_POINTER.
